topSql.sqlText: SELECT MAX (IP.INDI_PROV_SK) AS INDI_PROV_SK, NULL AS NINDI_PROV_SK, MAX (IP.NPI_NUM) AS NPI_NUM, IP.SRC_SYS_CD AS BASESOURCE, IPN.NWK_ID, MAX (IPN.NWK_END_DT) AS NWK_END_DT, MIN (IPN.NWK_BG_DT) AS NWK_BG_DT FROM INDI_PROV IP JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN ON IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN.INDI_PROV_SK JOIN TABLE (CAST (:B1 AS T_NWK_TAB)) BPD ON IPN.NWK_ID = BPD.COLUMN_VALUE WHERE IPN.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND IPN.SRC_SYS_CD = :B3 AND IPN.NWK_ID = :B2 AND IP.NPI_NUM IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INDI_PROV IP1, INDI_PROV_NWK IPN1 WHERE IP1.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN1.INDI_PROV_SK AND IPN1.SRC_SYS_CD = 'DIR' AND IP1.SRC_SYS_CD = :B5 AND IPN1.NWK_ID = :B4 AND IP1.NPI_NUM = IP.NPI_NUM AND IPN1.NWK_END_DT = TO_DATE ('12/31/9999', 'MM/DD/YYYY')) GROUP BY NPI_NUM, IP.SRC_SYS_CD, IPN.NWK_ID
SELECT INDI_PROV_SK FROM INDI_PROV WHERE SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND NPI_NUM = :B1 AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT IP1.INDI_PROV_SK, IP1.NPI_NUM, IPN1.INDI_PROV_NWK_SK FROM INDI_PROV IP1 JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN1 ON IP1.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN1.INDI_PROV_SK WHERE IPN1.SRC_SYS_CD = 'DIR' AND IP1.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN1.NWK_ID = :B1 AND IPN1.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INDI_PROV IP JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN ON IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN.INDI_PROV_SK JOIN TABLE (CAST (:B3 AS T_NWK_TAB)) BPD ON IPN.NWK_ID = BPD.COLUMN_VALUE WHERE IPN.SRC_SYS_CD = :B4 AND IP.NPI_NUM = IP1.NPI_NUM AND IP.NPI_NUM IS NOT NULL AND IPN.NWK_END_DT = TO_DATE ('12/31/9999', 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND IPN.NWK_ID IN (SELECT CFG.SRC_NWK_ID FROM M_BCBSMI_SEL_NET_CONFIG CFG WHERE CFG.SRC_SYS_CD = :B4 AND CFG.TARGET_SYS_CD = :B2 AND CFG.DIR_NWK_ID = :B1 AND CFG.I_NI_TYPE = 'INDI' AND CFG.SPECIAL_INSTR = 'INCLUDE' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN CFG.RULE_BG_DT AND CFG.RULE_END_DT))

WITH EXCLUDED_NPI AS (SELECT IP2.NPI_NUM FROM INDI_PROV IP2 JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN2 ON IP2.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN2.INDI_PROV_SK JOIN TABLE (CAST (:B1 AS T_NWK_TAB)) BPD ON IPN2.NWK_ID = BPD.COLUMN_VALUE WHERE IP2.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN2.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN2.NWK_END_DT = TO_DATE ('12/31/9999', 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND IPN2.NWK_ID IN (SELECT CFG.SRC_NWK_ID FROM M_BCBSMI_SEL_NET_CONFIG CFG WHERE CFG.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND CFG.TARGET_SYS_CD = :B5 AND CFG.DIR_NWK_ID = :B4 AND CFG.I_NI_TYPE = 'INDI' AND CFG.SPECIAL_INSTR = 'INCLUDE' AND CFG.SRC_NWK_ID <> :B3 AND ( STT_CD IS NULL OR PMY_SPTY_CD IS NULL) AND SYSDATE BETWEEN CFG.RULE_BG_DT AND CFG.RULE_END_DT)) SELECT DISTINCT IP.NPI_NUM, NULL AS DUMMY FROM INDI_PROV IP JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN ON IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN.INDI_PROV_SK JOIN TABLE (CAST (:B1 AS T_NWK_TAB)) BPD ON IPN.NWK_ID = BPD.COLUMN_VALUE WHERE IP. SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN.NWK_ID = :B3 AND IPN.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EXCLUDED_NPI EN WHERE EN.NPI_NUM = IP.NPI_NUM) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INDI_PROV IP1 JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN1 ON IP1.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN1.INDI_PROV_SK WHERE IPN1.SRC_SYS_CD = 'DIR' AND IP1.NPI_NUM = IP.NPI_NUM AND IP1.SRC_SYS_CD = :B5 AND IPN1.NWK_ID = :B4 AND IPN1.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE)

SELECT IP1.INDI_PROV_SK, IP1.NPI_NUM, IPN1.INDI_PROV_NWK_SK FROM INDI_PROV IP1 JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN1 ON IP1.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN1.INDI_PROV_SK WHERE IPN1.SRC_SYS_CD = 'DIR' AND IP1.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN1.NWK_ID = :B1 AND IPN1.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INDI_PROV IP JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN ON IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN.INDI_PROV_SK JOIN TABLE (CAST (:B3 AS T_NWK_TAB)) BPD ON IPN.NWK_ID = BPD.COLUMN_VALUE WHERE IPN.SRC_SYS_CD = :B4 AND IP.NPI_NUM = IP1.NPI_NUM AND IP.NPI_NUM IS NOT NULL AND IPN.NWK_ID IN (SELECT CFG.SRC_NWK_ID FROM M_BCBSMI_SEL_NET_CONFIG CFG WHERE CFG.SRC_SYS_CD = :B4 AND CFG.TARGET_SYS_CD = :B2 AND CFG.DIR_NWK_ID = :B1 AND CFG.I_NI_TYPE = 'INDI' AND CFG.SPECIAL_INSTR = 'INCLUDE' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN CFG.RULE_BG_DT AND CFG.RULE_END_DT))

SELECT IPL.STT_CD FROM INDI_PROV IP, INDI_PROV_LOC IPL WHERE IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPL.INDI_PROV_SK AND IP.INDI_PROV_SK = :B2 AND IPL.LOC_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND INSTR ( ', ' || :B1 || ', ', ', ' || IPL.STT_CD || ', ') > 0 AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT 1 FROM INDI_PROV_NWK WHERE SRC_SYS_CD = 'DIR' AND INDI_PROV_SK = :B3 AND ( NINDI_PROV_SK = :B2 OR ( NINDI_PROV_SK IS NULL AND :B2 IS NULL)) AND NWK_ID = :B1 AND NWK_END_DT = TO_DATE ('12/31/9999', 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT IP.INDI_PROV_SK FROM INDI_PROV IP JOIN INDI_PROV_NWK IPN ON IP.INDI_PROV_SK = IPN.INDI_PROV_SK WHERE IP.NPI_NUM = :B3 AND IP.SRC_SYS_CD = :B2 AND IPN.NWK_ID = :B1 AND IPN.NWK_END_DT >= SYSDATE AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT COUNT (*) FROM INDI_PROV_TYPE_SPTY S INNER JOIN CODES C ON C.CODE = S.SPTY_TYPE_CD AND C.CODE_TYPE = :B1 AND C.SRC = 'PORTICO' AND C.CURRENT_ACT = 'Y' WHERE ( S.TYPE_SPTY_END_DT >= SYSDATE OR S.TYPE_SPTY_END_DT IS NULL) AND S.INDI_PROV_SK = :B2
